name: Eating Meat
overview: Scripture reveals that God's original provision for human nourishment was plant-based, as seen in Genesis 1:29 where God grants every herb and fruit for food. After the Flood, however, God expanded this provision to include all moving creatures as meat for man, as stated in Genesis 9:3. The Old Testament law, introduced through Moses and Aaron (Leviticus 11:1), further regulated which animals were permissible to eat, reflecting God's holiness and order. In the New Testament, Jesus clarifies that what enters the mouth does not defile the heart (Mark 7:19), and Paul encourages believers to accept those with differing convictions about food without judgment (Romans 14:1), emphasizing faith and unity over dietary disputes.
